CatalogVersionRef.title: CatalogVersionRef

LuaContext.description:
Which Lua execution context a catalog entry or observation entry came from.

Shared by ``ObservationEntry.context`` (models/turn.py) and
``ParityDeclaration.context`` (models/catalog.py) -- both name the same
two contexts (contracts/capability-catalog.md), so it is defined once
here rather than twice.
LuaContext.title: LuaContext

ObservationEntry.description:
One piece of structured state, attributed to the catalog entry that produced it.

``declaration_id`` is required -- there is no unattributed-value path
(FR-016, SC-007).
ObservationEntry.title: ObservationEntry

description:
The view assembled for one decision step (FR-012, FR-024).

``decision_step_id`` is step-scoped, not turn-scoped: this is what makes
the observation the effect of the *previous* step's decision, assembled
fresh every time (FR-008).
title: Observation
